$comment: Screens tests/e2e/a11y.spec.js checks with axe-core. This file belongs to the plugin: apply-template.py only writes it when it is missing. The fields are described in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.

screens.name: Runtime Doctor, with critical results and every row expanded
setup: $r = get_option( 'axle_runtime_doctor_report' ); $r['results']['opcache_coverage']['status'] = 'critical'; $r['results']['opcache_coverage']['summary'] = 'OPcache is skipping wp-content'; $r['results']['opcache_coverage']['details'][] = 'opcache.blacklist_filename: "/var/www/html/wp-content/*" in /usr/local/etc/php/ard-blacklist.txt (line 1) matches wp-content'; $r['results']['object_cache_roundtrip']['status'] = 'critical'; $r['results']['object_cache_roundtrip']['summary'] = 'The object cache forgets everything between requests'; $r['results']['php_input_vars']['status'] = 'recommended'; $r['results']['php_input_vars']['summary'] = 'Saving the menu "Big footer" (1200 items) loses items'; $r['counts'] = AryanX\Axle\RuntimeDoctor\Runner::counts( $r['results'] ); update_option( 'axle_runtime_doctor_report', $r, false );

screens.name: Runtime Doctor, history before any run
Runtime Doctor, history with a regression
setup: $s = get_option( 'axle_runtime_doctor_snapshots' ); $first = $s[0]; $first['time'] -= DAY_IN_SECONDS; $first['results']['fs_config']['status'] = 'good'; $first['regressions'] = array(); $s[0]['regressions'] = array( 'fs_config' ); update_option( 'axle_runtime_doctor_snapshots', array( $first, $s[0] ), false );

screens.name: Regression notice on the dashboard
setup: update_option( 'axle_runtime_doctor_notice', array( 'time' => time(), 'regressions' => array( array( 'id' => 'opcache_coverage', 'label' => 'OPcache coverage', 'before' => 'good', 'after' => 'critical', 'summary' => 'OPcache is skipping wp-content' ) ) ), false );
